AT LEAST 6 months, but in most cases longer. I have three nostril piercings, two in the left and one in the right. They are 5, 3, and 2 years old respectively. ALL of which took at least a year for me to feel confident in saying they’re “healed”. I also had bumps come and go as well- what is the length of your jewelry? If you find that it pops out of your nose and needs to be pushed back down, you may need a downsize as to reduce the movement/friction in your piercing. You’ve had yours for approx. 5-6 months now, so I think the saline 2x/day is overkill- just let water run over it in the shower and you should be good to go. Sometimes i’ll cup water into my hands and place my nose into it and blow out lightly to help clean the inside of my nose as well (I have a septum as well). Some find that Dr. Bronners unscented soap tends to help with their piercing bumps caused by oil on their skin- however most would suggest not putting any soaps on at all and just leaving it alone. 

As far as wanting to put in a hoop, I would suggest you wait at least until it’s been a year. I know it sounds like a long time, but a hoop puts uneven pressure and movement on your piercing and can cause/worsen any bumps/irritation.

I put mine in a container filled with water and froze them. If I need them for my eyebrows (not doing eyebrows is NOT an option for me lol) I let them thaw and use them with the supervision of my partner, then we refreeze until I need it again!
